title: Nvidia nears deal for scaled-down investment in OpenAI: report
title_zh: Nvidia 接近达成缩减 OpenAI 投资的协议：报告
summary: Nvidia is on the cusp of investing $30 billion in OpenAI, scaling back a plan to pump $100 billion into the ChatGPT maker, the Financial Times reported Thursday.Huang made the remarks late in January after the Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia's plan to invest up to $10...
summary_zh: 据《金融时报》周四报道，Nvidia 即将向 OpenAI 投资 300 亿美元，从而缩减向 ChatGPT 制造商注资 1000 亿美元的计划。黄在 1 月底发表上述言论是在《华尔街日报》报道 Nvidia 计划投资最多 10 美元之后。

title: As Microsoft Extends 20% OpenAI Deal, Is the Bull Case for MSFT Stronger Here?
title_zh: 随着微软延长 20% 的 OpenAI 协议，微软的看涨理由是否更强？
summary: With Microsoft’s OpenAI revenue arrangement now extended through 2032, should investors see this as fresh fuel for the MSFT bull story?
summary_zh: 随着微软的 OpenAI 收入安排现已延长至 2032 年，投资者是否应该将其视为 MSFT 牛市故事的新动力？

title: The Buyout Case for Salesforce Is Real, but Marc Benioff Stands in the Way
title_zh: Salesforce 的收购案例是真实的，但马克·贝尼奥夫阻碍了
summary: Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) stock has shed almost 30% year-to-date, closing at $184.29 on February 17, 2026, down sharply from the $264.91 year-end close. That discount raises a question investors rarely ask about dominant software franchises: could Salesforce go private?
summary_zh: Salesforce（纽约证券交易所股票代码：CRM）股价今年迄今已下跌近 30%，2026 年 2 月 17 日收于 184.29 美元，较年末收盘价 264.91 美元大幅下跌。这种折扣引发了投资者很少询问主导软件特许经营权的一个问题：Salesforce 可以私有化吗？

title: Blackstone Expands Into Essential Home Services With Champions Group Deal
title_zh: Blackstone 通过 Champions Group 交易扩展到基本家庭服务
summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) has signed a definitive deal to acquire Champions Group, a major home services provider. The transaction will see Odyssey Investment Partners retain a significant minority stake in Champions Group.
summary_zh: Blackstone（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BX）已签署收购主要家庭服务提供商 Champions Group 的最终协议。此次交易将使 Odyssey Investment Partners 保留 Champions Group 的大量少数股权。

title: Citizens Financial Strengthens Advisory Platform With Matrix Deal
title_zh: Citizens Financial 通过 Matrix Deal 加强咨询平台
summary: CFG is set to expand its advisory platform through the planned acquisition of Matrix, expanding expertise in Downstream Energy & Convenience Retail.
summary_zh: CFG 将通过计划收购 Matrix 来扩大其咨询平台，扩大下游能源和便利零售领域的专业知识。
